content:
The **Mechanic's Best Friend** is a melee weapon in *Fallout 76*, introduced in the *Nuclear Winter* update.

A heavy metal wrench, speckled with rust and covered in chipped red paint. The weapon comes with the following Legendary Weapon Mods pre-attached:

| **Upgrade** | | | | | | | | | | | | 
| Mod | Description | Naming | Effects | | | | | Plan | Components | Form ID | | 
| Extra heavy | Chance to cripple. Extra limb damage. Superior damage. | Heavy | – | +5 | – | +0.6 | +10 | – | Adhesive x2 Lead x2 Screw x3 Steel x8 | 000975D3 | |
